evidence.title: GitHub - jal-co/shieldcn: Beautiful README badges, inspired by shields.io and styled like shadcn/ui.

name: shieldcn
summary: Shields.io alternative that renders GitHub README badges as shadcn/ui-style SVG and PNG images.
description: A badge image service: every badge renders in the look of a shadcn/ui Button, with 45+ providers (npm, GitHub, Discord, Reddit, PyPI, Docker, Bluesky, YouTube and more), plus charts (star history, issues, commits, npm downloads, inline JSON) and repository header banners. A free browser README Studio composes a whole GitHub README from text, header, badge, chart, table and image blocks, and an agent skill teaches coding agents to add badges.
contains: SVG and PNG badge images, no API keys or build step
badges rendered as shadcn/ui Button components
45+ providers incl. npm, GitHub, Discord, Reddit, PyPI, Docker, Bluesky and GitLab
charts: star history, GitHub issues, lifetime commits, npm downloads, inline JSON
README Studio: visual README builder (text, header, badge, chart, table, image)
agent skill installable via skills.sh for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 40+ agents
284 showcased badges on the showcase page
